Package com.neueda.leap.marketdata.controller

Class QuoteController

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.marketdata.controller.QuoteController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/quotes") public class QuoteController extends Object
Read-only REST API for market quotes.

Provides endpoints for retrieving latest quotes and bounded history for display purposes. The execution service has its own durable quote selection logic independent of this API.

All endpoints require JWT authentication (consistent with portfolio data endpoints). Security decision: Quotes are treated as protected financial data, similar to holdings and orders. This can be changed to public (permitAll) in SecurityConfig if market data should be freely accessible.

    • getLatestByMarketSymbol

      @GetMapping("/latest/by-market-symbol") public QuoteResponse getLatestByMarketSymbol(@RequestParam("market") String market, @RequestParam("symbol") String symbol)
      Retrieves the latest quote for an enabled, tradable instrument identified by market and symbol. Both parameters are trimmed and uppercased.
      Parameters:
      market - market identifier (e.g., "NASDAQ")
      symbol - instrument trading symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
      Returns:
      latest quote matching the market and symbol
      Throws:
      QuoteController.QuoteNotFoundException - if no eligible instrument or quote exists

    • getHistory

      @GetMapping("/history/{instrumentId}") public List<QuoteResponse> getHistory(@PathVariable UUID instrumentId, @RequestParam(value="limit",defaultValue="100",required=false) int limit)
      Retrieves bounded historical quotes for an instrument, ordered newest first. The limit is clamped to a safe maximum to prevent unbounded database reads.
      Parameters:
      instrumentId - persistent instrument identifier
      limit - maximum number of quotes to return (default 100, clamped to 1000)
      Returns:
      list of quotes, or empty when no quote exists
      Throws:
      QuoteController.QuoteNotFoundException - if the instrument does not exist
      IllegalArgumentException - if limit is invalid
